alt: An OpenAI brand-film composition layers wordmark-bearing photographic posters, yellow research layouts, a circular type specimen, and a colorful blue-orange image on a white background.
note: A complete frame from the commissioned identity film shows how photographic posters, scientific publishing, saturated color, and geometric typography work together. Large wordmarks connect the natural imagery to the company; grids and generous white space give the varied applications a shared structure.
provenance: Uncropped 1920 × 1080 frame at approximately 10.53 seconds from the public header film on Studio Dumbar’s OpenAI brand-film case study. The case study credits OpenAI Design Studio for the identity and Studio Dumbar for motion and sound.

title: With ChatGPT — window installation
alt: A tall airport advertising display shows people in the window of a pale blue Victorian building, photographed within a bright terminal.
note: A building facade becomes a portrait-format stage for a small human scene. The vertical panel, stacked architectural detail, and daylight palette give this execution a different rhythm from the warm horizontal billboards. The installation shows how the same photographic campaign adapts to a tall public surface.
provenance: Advertiser-submitted ChatGPT Billboard Campaign entry in the official OAAA creative library, with OpenAI named as advertiser and extensive OpenAI creative credits. Entry year 2026 is an award year, not asserted as a campaign publication date.

title: ChatGPT student campaign — poster wall
alt: A wall of white, yellow, and blue ChatGPT posters combines hand-drawn illustrations with simple prompt text and the ChatGPT wordmark.
note: Brand New School’s commissioned campaign pairs hand-drawn everyday objects with minimalist prompt typography. Alternating white and pastel panels create a calm visual rhythm across a complete public installation; the repeated wordmark and consistent drawing language carry the campaign.
provenance: Original public campaign image from commissioned studio Brand New School, whose case study explicitly credits client OpenAI.

title: ChatGPT student campaign — pasta recipe
alt: A ChatGPT billboard on a brick wall shows a prompt requesting a simple pasta recipe, a hand-drawn fork, and the ChatGPT wordmark.
note: A single useful request provides the concept and the composition. Large white space and an oversized doodle make the message legible in the street; warm brick and the soft paper-like background keep this product-led advertising approachable.
provenance: Original public campaign image from commissioned studio Brand New School, whose case study explicitly credits client OpenAI.

title: Grok 4.6 — orbital blacklight
alt: The white Grok 4.6 wordmark sits over a dark circular form with a softly glowing white rim on a smoky blue-gray field.
note: Official Grok 4.6 launch artwork. A softly illuminated orbital rim gives depth to the blue-black field; the centered white model name stays quiet against the optical drama. Light, blur, and negative space provide the identity.
provenance: Official announcement og:image, verified in page HTML; publication date verified from official page.

title: Grok — for decisions that matter
alt: A bright orange network of connected lights rises above the blue curve of Earth beneath the headline For decisions that matter, with a white Grok wordmark and The real world in real time tagline.
note: The illuminated planetary edge turns real-time information into a cinematic spatial metaphor. Fine orange connections climb into a dark sky, balancing the cool atmosphere below. A large, plain headline and the Grok wordmark give the image a clear campaign structure.
provenance: Campaign artwork indexed under the official @grok post URL by web image search; the original image was downloaded from X’s public media CDN. The post itself could not be read directly during curation, so its date is left unverified.

title: Imagine showcase — spaceflight photo book

title: Grok Voice 3.0 — violet optical wave
alt: White Grok Voice 3.0 lettering sits across a dark, softly textured wave with violet light on the left and magenta light at the upper right.
note: A sinuous dark channel divides saturated violet and magenta light. Soft focus and fine texture make the abstract surface feel optical and physical, while centered white product typography links it to Grok’s restrained launch identity.
provenance: Official announcement artwork, verified as og:image in the x.ai page HTML; the publication date is confirmed by the page’s time element and structured article metadata.

title: Imagine Image 2.0 — ember rim

This is the official launch treatment, distinct from the generated examples shown elsewhere on the announcement page.
